args.body:
Dear Customer,

We have approved a refund of **120 EUR** for the reshipping fee incurred due to the incorrect hardware delivery. The refund has been processed per our retention policies (RP-14).

**Reason**: Incorrect shipping to your registered site (Rotterdam DC-VZZ1).
**Next Steps**: Your corrected shipment is being processed. Estimated delivery date will be updated in your dashboard as soon as it is confirmed. If you require urgent attention, reply to this email.

Thank you for your patience.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
